synthesis: Separate boundary measurement (surface area) from interior capacity (volume) before selecting an operation.
Build a triangular right-prism surface-area calculation from two base triangles plus three side rectangles, then contrast with base-area-times-height volume.
Derive a cone lateral-area example through the invariant that the sector arc becomes the base circumference; distinguish slant height from perpendicular height.
Build a regular square-pyramid example from four congruent triangular faces plus the base and distinguish face slant height from solid height.
Add a worked misconception correction and a no-base packaging transfer task; all values, examples, prose and feedback are original.
